text: マサキ　から　レッドへ　ニシキが　おまえさんの　こと　めっちゃ　ほめとったで！

structure.jp: マサキ　から　レッドへ
おまえさんの　こと
めっちゃ　ほめとったで！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とった is the western-dialect form of ていた, 'was doing'. Bill speaks in Kansai dialect. ほめとった = 'was praising'.

patterns.name: 〜のこと
patterns.span: おまえさんの　こと
patterns.explanation: のこと after a person means 'things about that person', and is often used where English just says the person. The を after it is dropped in casual speech. おまえさんの　こと = 'you, about you'.

patterns.name: 〜で (Kansai よ)
patterns.explanation: で at the very end is the Kansai-dialect version of よ, used to tell someone something new. ほめとったで = 'he was praising you, you know!'.
